Note : 01

In accordance with Section 12(2) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 read with gazette notification DBR.PSBD.No.1084/16.13.100/2016-17 dated July 21, 2016, no shareholder in a banking company can exercise voting rights on poll in excess of 26% of total voting rights of all the shareholders of the banking company. Accordingly, Emirates NBD Bank (P.J.S.C.) ("ENBD") shall be entitled to exercise voting rights only up to 26%.

Note : 02

The board of directors of RBL Bank Limited (“Bank”) in its meeting held on June 18, 2026 (post all necessary approvals), approved the allotment of 92,91,34,820 fully paid-up equity shares of the Bank, each having a face value of INR 10, at a price of INR 280 per equity share, aggregating to INR 26,015,77,49,600 to Emirates NBD Bank (P.J.S.C) (“ENBD”), by way of a preferential issue on a private placement basis, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, the rules made thereunder, SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 (as amended), and other applicable laws.

Post the aforesaid preferential allotment, ENBD has been classified as a ‘promoter’ of the Bank.

On the basis of the above classification, 40 entities forming part of the ‘promoter group’ have been included in the shareholding pattern filed under the requirements of Regulation 31 (1) (b) of the Listing Regulations with the stock exchanges.

Note : 03
